description: Capability family registry. Each family names the authoritative sources for its public selector values, so the Tier-3 inventory is extracted rather than hand-maintained. 'public_surface' is the Python validation layer that decides what a user may actually select; C enums are deliberately NOT authoritative, because they carry values that are not exposed end to end.

symmetry.status_note: Declared in BC_TYPE_MAP and present in the C enum, but no public handler supports it, so reachability marks it latent. 'latent' is a computed reachability state, not a lifecycle status.

legacy_tokens.DUALTIME_PICARD_RK4: Accepted for archived .control files written before the Jameson rename. picurv never emits it; the deprecated YAML value normalizes to the canonical token.

families.title: LES Subgrid Models
families.coverage_note: Coverage is enforced. Both models were previously known-defective - the dynamic procedure built both terms of the Germano tensor from separately test-filtered quantities, so it had no dynamic content, and the constant model never produced an eddy viscosity on a fresh run. Both defects are fixed and carry mutation-tested unit coverage plus an end-to-end trend check. They are experimental rather than supported because no reference-flow comparison has been run: the decaying isotropic turbulence benchmark that would settle Cs near 0.16-0.17 has not been carried to a developed state.

families.title: Swept Cross-Sections
families.selector: grid.gen sweep --cross-section, or the `cross_section` config key

families.title: Wall Height Field Segments
families.selector: grid.gen box --wall-j-lo / --wall-j-hi, or the `wall_j_*` config keys

families.title: Centreline Path Segments
families.selector: grid.gen sweep --path, or the `path` config key

families.title: Storage Offload Policies
families.selector: picurv storage offload --policy / storage profile -> offload_policy

coverage_note: coverage_enforced marks families whose Tier-2 entries are complete. Every registered family is enforced; nothing is awaiting backfill. A newly registered family may be set advisory while its entries are being written, but it cannot reach a clean audit that way - the family census refuses a public selector surface no family covers, and this flag is checked for uniformity.
legacy_token_note: legacy_tokens declares C tokens intentionally still parsed but no longer emitted. They must be declared so an accidentally dead or misspelled arm is still caught.
evidence_note: Facets are independent claims, not a ladder. Each facet maps to source identifiers ('make:<target>', 'example:<dir>', 'file:<path>') that must exist AND must be cited in the capability entry's Evidence part. These are DECLARED evidence sources: automation checks existence and correspondence, not that the source establishes the claim. An empty mapping means 'implemented only'.
status_note: Only canonical values declare status. An accepted spelling inherits the status of the value it resolves to, so a defective capability cannot look supported under a different spelling.
